description: AI-native property MCP server for Northern Cyprus (KKTC). Nine read-only tools — search active listings, get the live price index, compare cities, estimate rental yield, look up KKTC legal procedures, profile districts, and more — pulled live from evlek.app, where every listing is KYC-verified. Compatible with Claude Desktop, ChatGPT Apps, Perplexity, Cursor, and any MCP client. Multilingual (TR, EN, RU, DE, AR), 6 cities (Girne, Lefkoşa, Gazimağusa, İskele, Güzelyurt, Lefke), GBP-primary pricing. First proptech in the region built MCP-first — making KKTC property data discoverable through AI assistants instead of fragmented websites.

findings.title: Excessive Permission Surface
findings.recommendation: Tool requests broad permissions (exec/fs/network). Validate input parameters using Enums where possible, and restrict file system operations to explicit allowed directories.

findings.title: DoS Resilience — Missing Rate Limit / Timeout
findings.description: tool performs network or execution operations but declares no rate-limit, timeout, or retry configuration
findings.recommendation: Declare explicit rate-limit, timeout, and retry configuration for all network and execution tools. Implement exponential back-off and surface resource state to the calling agent.
